entry_conditions: Drawer is open near 0.300 or partly closed and target_pose is finite. At early overlap entry the block may still descend/release over the cavity; later entry has the block settled near z 0.063 and an opening/open hand retreating.
exit_conditions: Drawer_position is below the unchanged 0.025 threshold and nearly stationary, the block remains inside near z 0.063, fingers are open, and the TCP is high and clear near the observed final z 0.358.
overlap_role: Every action 900:1160 in every trajectory is supervised. This 260-action, 13 s overlap covers release completion, cavity clearance, reorientation, handle approach and handle acquisition rather than using those states only as context.
successor_readiness: This is terminal. Readiness is based on observed closure, retained block and hand retreat; the supplied framework success definition is unchanged.
failure_signatures: Block remains coupled when drawer motion starts, block is outside the cavity, fingers miss/remain open at the handle, drawer stops above 0.025, block leaves during closure, IK residual or limits indicate infeasibility, or hand remains trapped.
continuation_guidance: Continue replanning while target_pose is reliable and drawer-frame displacement is the dominant variation. Prefer the TCP-local policy for local execution-state mismatch and the fixed-destination policy when partial closure/stopping is dominant. Do not interpret a close command as contact.
limitations: Observed successful trajectories do not demonstrate recovery from unseen contact loss, jam, obstruction, changed handle offset, severe displacement, collision, or unreachable pose.
